description: Newsroom tools: follow a watch (a name and the sources to read) and list the watches being followed.

newsroom_follow.description: Follow a new watch in the Newsroom: the Newsroom reads its sources on a timer and keeps what is new in the owner's feed. Use it when the user says 'keep an eye on …', 'follow …' or 'tell me when … has news'. A watch made here only fills the feed; it never sends a message and has no channel (the user picks one in the Newsroom screen). Each source is a kind and a target: 'feed' (an RSS or Atom URL, or a GitHub releases feed), 'hackernews' (a search word), 'mastodon' (a tag, with the instance), 'page' (a web page URL, watched for changes) or 'telegram' (a public channel name). Pass only sources the user named or that you know are real; do not invent URLs. 'interval' is optional (for example '1h'; the default and the shortest allowed are applied). The result describes the watch made: repeat its name and sources to the user. If this tool returns an error, the watch was NOT saved: tell the user.

name.description: A short name for the watch, e.g. 'Go releases'.

interval.description: How often to read, as a duration such as '1h'. Omit for the default.

look_for.description: What the user wants to know about, in their own words, e.g. 'new open-weight model releases, not ads'. The Newsroom keeps only items about it. Ask the user if they did not say; omit only when they want everything the sources post.

keywords.description: Optional. An item must contain at least one of these words to be looked at.

skip.description: Optional. An item containing any of these words is dropped.

sources.description: One or more sources to read.

target.description: The URL, search word, tag or channel name.

instance.description: For mastodon only: the instance host, e.g. 'mastodon.social'.

newsroom_watches.description: List the watches the Newsroom follows, with their sources, interval, channel and last result. Use it to answer 'what am I following?' and before adding a watch, to avoid a duplicate.
